related.title: IBM transmon：Josephson 能量與躍遷頻率
related.titleEn: IBM transmon: Josephson energy and transition frequency
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付80/100 fF能量表、單位鏈與待確認的 E_J 欄位。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver an80/100 fF energy table, unit chain, and unresolved E_J field. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IBM transmon：Josephson 能量與躍遷頻率』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付兩個頻率、反算結果及近似適用區間圖。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM transmon: Josephson energy and transition frequency', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver both frequencies, inverse results and an approximation-validity diagram.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：E_C=e²/(2C)，以 E_C/h 表示頻率；只描述集中電容，不包含接面損耗或完整能階。 使用合成電容 C=80 fF，e=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C，h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1.602176634e-19)**2/(2*80e-15*6.62607015e-34)/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：另以 C×(E_C/h) 的不變性檢查兩組，並驗證 fF→F 的10⁻¹⁵換算。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：當 E_J/E_C≫1，f01≈sqrt(8(E_J/h)(E_C/h))−E_C/h；所有頻率須同用 GHz。 使用教學 E_J/h=20 GHz、E_C/h=0.25 GHz，比例80；模型忽略更高階修正。 以手算或試算表計算名義式sqrt(8*20*0.25)-0.25，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以(f01+0.25)²/(8×0.25)反推 E_J/h，兩組應回到20與18。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: E_C=e²/(2C), expressed as frequency E_C/h; this lumped-capacitance model excludes junction loss and the full spectrum. Use Synthetic C=80 fF, e=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C, h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s. Evaluate nominal expression (1.602176634e-19)**2/(2*80e-15*6.62607015e-34)/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Independently check the invariant C×(E_C/h) and the10⁻¹⁵ conversion from fF to F.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For E_J/E_C≫1, f01≈sqrt(8(E_J/h)(E_C/h))−E_C/h; all frequencies use GHz. Use Teaching E_J/h=20 GHz and E_C/h=0.25 GHz give ratio80; higher-order corrections are excluded. Evaluate nominal expression sqrt(8*20*0.25)-0.25 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Invert using(f01+0.25)²/(8×0.25); recover20 and18 for the two cases.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IBM Heron 控制：殘留 ZZ 與待機相位
related.titleEn: IBM Heron control: residual ZZ and idle phase
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付80/100 fF能量表、單位鏈與待確認的 E_J 欄位。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver an80/100 fF energy table, unit chain, and unresolved E_J field. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IBM Heron 控制：殘留 ZZ 與待機相位』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付條件Ramsey差分、相位預算與多鄰居待測矩陣。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM Heron control: residual ZZ and idle phase', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver differential Ramsey data, phase budget and a multi-neighbor test matrix.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：E_C=e²/(2C)，以 E_C/h 表示頻率；只描述集中電容，不包含接面損耗或完整能階。 使用合成電容 C=80 fF，e=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C，h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1.602176634e-19)**2/(2*80e-15*6.62607015e-34)/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：另以 C×(E_C/h) 的不變性檢查兩組，並驗證 fF→F 的10⁻¹⁵換算。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：用條件頻移ζ的累積相位φ=2πζt；此處ζ是Hz而非rad/s，結果以rad表示。 使用合成殘留ζ=20 kHz，待機t=1 μs；不假設廠商實際數值。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*pi*20e3*1e-6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：比較鄰居準備|0⟩與|1⟩的Ramsey相位差，並用0.5/1 μs兩窗檢查線性。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: E_C=e²/(2C), expressed as frequency E_C/h; this lumped-capacitance model excludes junction loss and the full spectrum. Use Synthetic C=80 fF, e=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C, h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s. Evaluate nominal expression (1.602176634e-19)**2/(2*80e-15*6.62607015e-34)/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Independently check the invariant C×(E_C/h) and the10⁻¹⁵ conversion from fF to F.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Accumulate phase φ=2πζt for conditional frequency shift ζ; ζ is Hz, not rad/s, and phase is rad. Use Synthetic residual ζ=20 kHz and idle t=1 μs; these are not vendor values. Evaluate nominal expression 2*pi*20e3*1e-6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Compare Ramsey phase for neighboring |0⟩ and |1⟩ states and test linearity with0.5/1 μs windows.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
